    def check_self_intersections(n: int, points: List[int]) -> str:

        points.sort()
        
        # Active intervals to keep track of semi-circles

import sys

def check_self_intersections(n: int, points: List[int]) -> str:
    # Sort points by their x-coordinates
    points.sort()
    
    # Initialize a list to keep track of active semi-circles
    active_semi_circles = []
    
    for i in range(1, n):
        x1, x2 = points[i-1], points[i]
        
        # Check for intersections with all active semi-circles
        for j in range(len(active_semi_circles)):
            y1, y2 = active_semi_circles[j]
            # Calculate the center and radius of the current semi-circle
            center_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
            radius = abs(x2 - x1) / 2
            
            # Check if the new semi-circle intersects with the existing one
            if abs(center_x - (y1 + y2) / 2) < radius + abs(y2 - y1) / 2:
